name: Análisis de Residuos de Ruido
description: Examina high-frequency patrón de ruidos by applying Wiener deconvolution. Real cameras produce characteristic sensor noise that varies a través de the image, while AI generates unnaturally uniform patrón de ruidos.
mechanism:
The análisis process:

1. **Noise extraction**: Aplica Wiener deconvolution filter to separate the noise component from image content.

2. **Local varianza mapping**: Computes local noise varianza a través de overlapping blocks to create a noise varianza heatmap.

3. **Uniformity análisis**: Real camera noise varies due to sensor manufacturing imperfections (No Uniformidad de Respuesta Fotónica). AI images lack this variation.

4. **Statistical profiling**: Analiza distribución de ruido statistics (kurtosis, skewness) against known camera noise models.
parameters:
Filter: Wiener deconvolution, Window: 5x5
Tamaño de bloque: 16x16 with 50% overlap
Noise model: Gaussian + Poisson (heteroscedastic)
Metrics: local varianza, kurtosis, skewness
accuracy: High - 80-90% for distinguishing natural vs synthetic noise
useCase: Detección de imágenes de IA a través de patrones de ruido anormalmente uniformes. También se usa para identificación de fuente de cámara y detección de manipulación.

references.title: Chen, M. et al. (2008). Determining Image Origin and Integrity Using Sensor Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Lukas, J., Fridrich, J. & Goljan, M. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020). Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Robust against content manipulación
• Camera-specific noise is extremely difficult to forge
• Works a través de different image formats
• Can identify specific camera models
limitations:
• Effectiveness reduced by heavy denoising or compression
• Requires sufficient image resolución
• Some AI models now add synthetic noise to evade detección
• Social media compression degrades patrón de ruidos
